ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How fast the day passes and how the weather changes, the same for everyone.
ADMIN_C_TIME_DESC: The in-game clock every player sees.
ADMIN_H_SCALE: Game minutes per real minute: 2 makes a game day last 12 real hours, 30 is GTA Online's 48 minutes.
ADMIN_H_START_HOUR: The clock starts at this hour when the server starts.
ADMIN_H_FREEZE: Time stands still at the current hour.
ADMIN_C_WEATHER_DESC: The weather changes by itself through the list, or stays.
ADMIN_H_DYNAMIC: Off: the first weather of the list stays.
ADMIN_H_WEATHERS: GTA weather names in the order they follow (EXTRASUNNY, CLEAR, CLOUDS, OVERCAST, RAIN, THUNDER, CLEARING, FOGGY, SMOG, SNOW, XMAS...).
ADMIN_H_BLACKOUT: City lights go out (vehicles keep their lights).
ADMIN_C_SNOW_DESC: How snow weather (snow, light snow, blizzard, christmas) feels in the game.
ADMIN_H_SNOW_GRIP: How much wheels slip in christmas snow: 0 drives like dry road, GTA's default is 0.2, 1 is ice.
ADMIN_H_SNOW_GROUND: Covers the ground white and leaves tyre and footprint tracks while it snows.
ADMIN_TAB_REGIONS_DESC: Parts of the map with their own weather, such as snowy mountains or a dry desert.
ADMIN_C_REGION_DESC: Inside the circle players see this region's weather instead of the world's; the smallest circle wins where they overlap.
ADMIN_H_REGION_CENTER: The middle of the region on the ground.
ADMIN_H_REGION_RADIUS: How far the region reaches from its centre (any height).
ADMIN_H_REGION_WEATHERS: The weathers this region steps through, in order.
